name: Authorize.Net (Visa Acceptance)

webhook.algorithm: VERIFIED. Header `X-ANET-Signature`, value formatted `sha512=<hex>`. HMAC-SHA512 of the raw notification body keyed by the merchant's Signature Key (found under Account > Settings > Security Settings > API Credentials and Keys). No timestamp is signed — event-id dedup required.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: VERIFIED shape: three separate credentials — API Login ID, Transaction Key, and a hex Signature Key used only for webhooks. No `sk_`/`pk_` prefix exists. Sandbox base URL `https://apitest.authorize.net`, production `https://api.authorize.ne

onboarding.note: A gateway, not an acquirer: you also need your own merchant account, which is a separate underwriting process. That is exactly why it serves verticals other providers ban.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN — Authorize.Net charges a gateway fee (monthly + per-transaction); the actual processing rate comes from the separate merchant account and is negotiated. This split is the point: a generator must not present one blended number here.

notes: It is the gateway-with-your-own-merchant-account architecture, and that architecture — not any particular brand — is the only thing that works for the regulated verticals in this cluster. Firearms/FFL, CBD, nutraceuticals, kratom, gun ranges, ammunition and most 'high-risk' MCCs are banned outright by Stripe, Square and every aggregator in the shipped set. Those merchants get a dedicated MID from a high-risk acquirer (Easy Pay Direct, Corepay, PaymentCloud, Durango) and point it at a gateway. PagoKit currently has no template for that shape at all.

SDKs: Official SDKs for PHP, Node, Python, Java, .NET, Ruby (`authorizenet` on npm/PyPI, `authorizenet/authorizenet` on Packagist). Long-lived, but the API is XML/JSON-over-POST in an older idiom than Stripe's. Not re-verified this session beyond the docs page.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Represents the same slot as NMI. Overlaps nothing shipped — Stripe/MercadoPago/Wompi/LemonSqueezy are all aggregator or MoR models.
